text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text:
This strength... I hate to admit it,
but he lives up to his name as an Archbishop of Sin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この力……
悔しいですが、
魔女教の大罪司教なだけのことはありますね！

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text:
Even with our magic, defeating him won't be easy.
What an irritating pest of a man.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラムたちの魔法でも、
仕留めるのは難しそうね。
本当にいまいましいやつだわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong he might be,
I can never forgive him for what he's done!
Your crimes end here, villain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんなにすごい力を持っていようと、
こんなひどいことをした人を、
私は許さない！
そこまでよ、
悪党！
